title and abstract.summary: The study measured the relationships between the functional traits (mobility, voltinism, and overwintering stage) of diurnal Lepidoptera (butterflies and burnet moths) and the landscape structure across a gradient from nature reserves to intensive farmland in Baden-Württemberg, SW Germany.

introduction.summary: This study analyzed abundance data for butterflies and burnet moths collected during the first two years of a large-scale insect monitoring program to reveal relationships between their functional traits and environmental variables, particularly landscape composition.
